services.desc: Every trip we make sure that we’re at our best by providing a fun, safe trip with a helpful, hard-working crew with great attitudes. While our goal is to put you on fish, it is called “fishing” not “catching.” We want to make sure your expectations are realistic, so you can make an educated decision about spending your money. Fishing changes daily and fishing regulations have become stringent due to poor fisheries management. We have a lot of trips where everyone catches keeper fish. We also have a lot of trips where only a handful of people catch keeper fish. On rare occasions, we have trips where only a couple or possibly no one catches a keeper fish.
